responsibility: Performs the interprocedural mod/ref analysis that summarizes loads, stores, escapes, and fnspec effects. It builds per-function and per-call summaries, propagates them across SCCs in the callgraph, streams LTO forms, and updates signatures and aliasing information so later passes can reason about memory side effects more precisely.
same_name_distinction: Implements the mod/ref analysis passes and propagation engine that compute and transitively close function and call summaries across the callgraph and SCCs, including LTO streaming forms, fnspec/escape summaries, signature updates, and final cleanup. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref.h, it performs the analysis and dataflow rather than merely defining the public summary shape and accessor hooks.
